value.body: An animal health technical officer is the veterinary expert in the field for a company making animal medicines, vaccines or feed. Animal-health pharma, vaccine and feed companies hire them. The work involves visiting farms and vets, explaining products, advising on disease control and running field trials.

items.label: Work setting
items.value: Field-based, with travel to dairy, poultry and other livestock units

items.label: Livestock population
items.note: Includes ~19.2 crore cattle and ~11 crore buffaloes; the 21st census was under way in 2025

items.label: Milk production
items.source: Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2025, DAHD (as reported)

items.label: Egg production
items.source: Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2025, DAHD (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join as a technical officer or veterinary sales and services officer through company recruitment. Registration with the veterinary council is generally expected.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: technical manager, product manager, regional technical lead.
Sales targets are often part of the role alongside technical work.
An MVSc can open specialised technical and research roles.
